goal: GroundAtlas native functional/visual parity with the web product inside the requested macOS-style shell
constraints: C++/Qt/OpenGL native UI; no WebView, Electron or Tauri wrapper.
Preserve source labels, spatial coverage, unknown heights and scientific limitations.
The macOS-style window shell is a user-requested native desktop adaptation.
Parity is complete only after each supported web workflow is verified on desktop.
A feature that is unavailable on the web is not a claim that the desktop implements its model.

statusDefinitions.partial: A subset exists; not equivalent to web
statusDefinitions.implemented: Native implementation exists; acceptance checks pending
statusDefinitions.web-unavailable: Web itself lacks an input/model; desktop must retain honest unavailable state
